visible_observation: The headline 'BELOW THE LAST LIGHT' is set in a standard, geometric sans-serif typeface with uniform weight and spacing. It is positioned in the upper third, floating over a gradient background without interacting with the vertical bioluminescent elements.
critique: The typography is visually inert and generic; it functions as a label rather than a visual material. The uniform, upright stance of the letters contradicts the verticality and fluidity of the deep-sea environment. The text sits 'on top' of the image rather than inhabiting the space, failing to convey the pressure or mystery of the deep ocean.
revision: Replace the standard sans-serif with a typeface that has vertical elongation or structural irregularity to mimic deep-sea forms. Apply a vertical gradient to the text fill (bright white at the top fading to dark blue/black at the bottom) to simulate the text descending into the abyss and disappearing into the darkness.
protected_strength: The atmospheric background gradient and the delicate, glowing vertical line art that establishes the deep-sea setting.
